note: v11: 'sixth' (1:12.3-1:41.6): the fifteens get a drum (the floor tom on D flat 2) and the bar gets one (the C tom) and a note (the left wall on C): fifteen against sixteen, D flat against C, the gap between the two strokes a sixteenth wider every bar

v15: 'fourth' (1:41.6-2:11.0): the two voices of the count-in sing the tune's long notes as their numbers (nine, fifteen, twelve: each as long as it says, on the tune's own note and its octave) over the clean pair's nines and fifteens; the lead rests on them and answers with the quick turn

v19: sixteen is said (2:10.97-2:12.80). At the change of gear the band strikes once and stops; the two voices sing the D flat they sang as 'fifteen' once more, the same length, as 'six-teen'; the band comes in a bar later on a crash.
